citations.assessment: The full Akko descriptor is explicit in the teaching comparing a single evening without Shema.
The Akko descriptor distinguishes this speaker from bar Hanilai two passages earlier.
Full name including Akko, with Rav Hiyya as honorific form.
Tanhum of Akko transmits from Yaakov bar Aha in the name of Simlai, with alternatives. Rav Aha’s epithet in the adjoining Heilprin clause is a distinct notice.
The Bavli has Tanhum bar Hiyya without Akko and says all the statues were cut down. Keep the Warsaw uprooted wording, shared with Ein Yaakov.
Directly confirms the Akko qualifier and the uprooted verb as a distinct reading.

evidence.witness: En Jacob, translated by SH Glick, 1916
